Equipment: Pounder; drying surfaces; earthen storage container reported in one Sivasagar study
Method_Description: A 2023 field study documented ÉPOP preparation using 31 plant species across 22 families in Sivasagar district; plant materials were dried, crushed and mixed with soaked glutinous rice, formed into cakes, inoculated with prior starter material and dried for storage.
Reported_Duration_or_Conditions: One study reports prepared starter cakes can be stored up to six months; this is not a universal guarantee.
